moves.label: Quick Fusion Jab
moves.description: Quick high jab with a long active check that keeps close pressure moving.

moves.label: Low Fusion Sweep
moves.description: Slow low sliding kick that reaches the shin line with weak left-side coverage.

moves.label: Fusion Body Blow
moves.description: Quick mid punch with a short active window for checking step-ins.

moves.label: Heavy Fusion Kick
moves.description: Slow mid kick with a sweeping leg arc and enough recovery to feel committed.

cmd:O+2.label: Final Kamehameha Drive
cmd:O+2.description: Charge fused blue and gold ki at the palms, then release Vegito's launching Final Kamehameha.
